standard-dialogue-carrying-2.npc: Master says move this rock, move that rock. I said no, much more fun to smash 'em. Master didn't like that. Kicked me into lava. I obey for now.
One day I get big revenge. Masters lair will be mine!
Methinks redecorate. More cages, more skulls.
Of course! You not like yours? Make donation?

standard-dialogue-carrying-3.npc: Urgh... So... Heavy... But toiling makes me big and strong like master, yes?

standard-dialogue-carrying-overhead.npc: Where did I need to take this?
Can't wait to start smashing again...
If I deliver this in time, master won't give me the hoof!
So much to do. So little time.
Must work hard... Mustn't get clobbered...
Me remember everything, me not forget faces.
Did I pick up the right relic?

standard-dialogue-tinkering-1.npc: Hey, you're hitting my half of the relic!
So that's my half! That's what!
If it's your half, why am I hitting it?
Grrrrr! I hate working with you.
Maybe you go take a break, then I can smash the whole thing!

standard-dialogue-tinkering-1.player: What you two need is some conflict resolution!

standard-dialogue-tinkering-1.npc: Yeah! Keep your eyes off our relic!

standard-dialogue-tinkering-2.npc: This looks so much better already!

standard-dialogue-tinkering-3.npc: We can flickedy flam these stones better than anyone else! A-boom-boom-boom!
Do you feel the rhythm? Start dancing, human!

steps.text: The player performs the dance emote.

steps.player: Absolutely no way am I dancing for you!

steps.npc: We make you dance one day, somehow...
Me know humans don't like pointy sticks!
Ooh yes, we prod them good!

standard-dialogue-reading-1.player: Hi there little fella, what's on that scroll?

standard-dialogue-reading-2.npc: D - E - Z - Y - O - G - T - O - N.
Dezyogton? What's that mean? Me too stupid to read.

standard-dialogue-reading-2.player: Can I take a look at that scroll?
Terrible handwriting, I can see why you're struggling.

standard-dialogue-reading-2.npc: Struggling? Me's a foolish little imp! Of course me struggle!

standard-dialogue-reading-2.player: It says destruction of the mortal mind.

standard-dialogue-reading-2.npc: It does? What else does it say? Keep reading.

standard-dialogue-reading-2.player: Erm... In full, it says that reading this scroll will cause destruction of the mortal mind.

standard-dialogue-reading-2.npc: Oh really? That's not good! You probably shouldn't have read it! Teehee!

standard-dialogue-reading-2.player: It also says that I stink?

standard-dialogue-reading-3.npc: Sitting by the fire, reading my favourite scroll, this is the life!
It's called 'an introduction to flaying'. I like the pictures.

standard-dialogue-reading-overhead.npc: This is pointless. I should be stealing things.
I'll throw this into lava soon...
Argh. I can't make sense of these symbols!
Do I really need to be able to read?

standard-dialogue-jumping-1.npc: Hop! Hop! Take that you stupid rock!

standard-dialogue-jumping-2.npc: Me wrecky relic! Me wrecky relic! Hahaha!

standard-dialogue-jumping-overhead.npc: Oh no, is the relic starting to break? Oops!
I can jump higher than you all!

standard-dialogue-dying-in-yama-s-lair-f.npc: Gratz on your Nightmare Mode loss
Seriously, you died to a 1? Eat a cabbage next time, then you might survive. Yuck.
